"""Freeze/check the new run offline; activate/run require exact frozen-package activation."""

# ruff: noqa: E402
import argparse
import asyncio
import fcntl
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT / "scripts"), str(ROOT / "backend")]
from acceptance_support.five_hour_runtime import (
    private_directory,
    read_json,
    require,
    write_once,
)
from acceptance_support.luna_admission_gate import env_metadata
from acceptance_support.plan_admission_live import (
    DATABASE,
    execute,
    live_gateway,
    verify_database,
)
from acceptance_support.plan_admission_run import (
    Ledger,
    RUN_ID,
    check_assessment,
    schedule,
)
from acceptance_support.qwen_review_budget import canonical, sha
from prepare_plan_admission import BASE as PARENT, check as check_parent
from run_five_hour_acceptance import load_keys

PACKAGE = ROOT / "docs/acceptance/phase-1-plan-admission-execution-r01"
APPROVAL = ROOT / "docs/acceptance/phase-1-plan-admission-authorization-r01"
PRIVATE = ROOT / "local-materials/phase-1-plan-admission-execution-r01"
PARENT_HASH = "b99c08f657b084c849b36163339fe0526f484b40d7f76a991d8e99cca7653303"


def read(path):
    return read_json(path)


def slots():
    return schedule(read(PARENT / "index.json"))


def verify_authorization():
    require(
        sha((PARENT / "manifest.json").read_bytes()) == PARENT_HASH, "PARENT_CHANGED"
    )
    check_parent()  # Historical pending fields stay immutable; receipt below supplies current authority.
    a, h = (
        read(APPROVAL / "approval.json"),
        read(APPROVAL / "human-check-20261021.json"),
    )
    require(
        a["parent_manifest_sha256"] == PARENT_HASH
        and h["parent_manifest_sha256"] == PARENT_HASH
        and h["approval_sha256"] == sha((APPROVAL / "approval.json").read_bytes())
        and a["budget"]["executable_request_max"] == 59
        and a["timing"]["global_deadline_seconds"] == 18000
        and a["first_failure"]["stop"] is True
        and a["automatic_retries"] == 0
        and a["fallbacks"] == 0
        and h["signed_by"] == "Lee"
        and h["changes_reported"] is False,
        "APPROVAL_CHANGED",
    )
    expected = [x for x in read(PARENT / "index.json")["materials"] if "prelabel" in x]
    require(len(h["materials"]) == len(expected) == 16, "ALL_LABELS_REQUIRED")
    for x, y in zip(expected, h["materials"], strict=True):
        require(
            y["id"] == x["id"]
            and y["lane"] == x["lane"]
            and y["independent_signoff"] == "confirmed_Lee"
            and y["material_sha256"] == x["sha256"]
            and y["prelabel_sha256"] == sha(canonical(x["prelabel"])),
            "LABEL_SIGNATURE_CHANGED",
        )


def freeze():
    require(not (PACKAGE / "manifest.json").exists(), "FROZEN_PACKAGE_CANNOT_REWRITE")
    verify_authorization()
    validations = [
        read(PACKAGE / p) for p in ("offline-tests.json", "pg-integration.json")
    ]
    require(
        all(v["exit"] == 0 and v["provider_calls"] == 0 for v in validations),
        "ACTUAL_OFFLINE_VALIDATION_REQUIRED",
    )
    environment = read(PACKAGE / "environment-check.json")
    require(
        environment
        == dict(
            database=DATABASE,
            head="0033_learning_shared_budget",
            empty=True,
            provider_calls=0,
        ),
        "ISOLATION_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED",
    )
    files = [ROOT / p for p in read(PARENT / "manifest.json")["files"]]
    files.extend(
        [
            ROOT / "scripts/run_plan_admission.py",
            ROOT / "scripts/acceptance_support/plan_admission_run.py",
            ROOT / "scripts/acceptance_support/plan_admission_live.py",
            ROOT / "scripts/tests/test_plan_admission_execution.py",
        ]
    )
    files.extend(p for p in PACKAGE.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    files.extend(p for p in APPROVAL.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    manifest = dict(
        kind="PLAN_ADMISSION_EXECUTION_FROZEN_NOT_ACTIVATED",
        run_id=RUN_ID,
        parent_manifest_sha256=PARENT_HASH,
        branch=subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "branch", "--show-current"], cwd=ROOT, text=True
        ).strip(),
        slots=slots(),
        requests_max=59,
        wall_seconds=18000,
        first_failure_stop=True,
        automatic_retries=0,
        fallbacks=0,
        database=DATABASE,
        env_metadata=env_metadata(ROOT / ".env"),
        files={
            str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(set(files))
        },
        activation_required=True,
        provider_calls=0,
        T040="blocked",
        holdout="sealed_not_used",
    )
    write_once(PACKAGE / "manifest.json", manifest)


def verify():
    verify_authorization()
    m = read(PACKAGE / "manifest.json")
    require(
        m["kind"] == "PLAN_ADMISSION_EXECUTION_FROZEN_NOT_ACTIVATED"
        and m["slots"] == slots()
        and m["requests_max"] == 59
        and m["wall_seconds"] == 18000
        and m["first_failure_stop"] is True
        and m["automatic_retries"] == m["fallbacks"] == 0
        and m["database"] == DATABASE,
        "EXECUTION_CONTRACT_CHANGED",
    )
    require(
        m["branch"]
        == subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "branch", "--show-current"], cwd=ROOT, text=True
        ).strip(),
        "BRANCH_CHANGED",
    )
    require(
        m["env_metadata"] == env_metadata(ROOT / ".env"), "CREDENTIAL_METADATA_CHANGED"
    )
    for name, h in m["files"].items():
        p = ROOT / name
        require(
            p.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
            and p.is_file()
            and not p.is_symlink()
            and sha(p.read_bytes()) == h,
            "FROZEN_FILE_CHANGED",
        )
    return sha((PACKAGE / "manifest.json").read_bytes())


def activated(manifest_hash):
    # Created only after explicit approval to start this concrete frozen executor.
    a = read(PACKAGE / "activation.json")
    require(
        a
        == dict(
            manifest_sha256=manifest_hash,
            decision="activate_plan_admission_execution_r01",
            reviewer="Lee",
            source_user_message=a.get("source_user_message"),
        )
        and bool(a["source_user_message"]),
        "EXACT_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED",
    )


def isolated_environment():
    import run_catalog_db_tests as isolated

    isolated.CONTAINER = "edumind-phase1-t037-pg"
    return isolated.test_environment(DATABASE)


def case_directory(spec):
    return private_directory(PRIVATE / spec["slot_id"].replace(":", "_"))


def verify_artifacts(directory, result):
    for name, h in result["artifact_hashes"].items():
        p = directory / name
        require(
            p.resolve().is_relative_to(directory.resolve())
            and not p.is_symlink()
            and sha(p.read_bytes()) == h,
            "RESULT_ARTIFACT_CHANGED",
        )


async def run_slot(ledger, spec, manifest_hash, keys, *, database_url=None):
    directory = case_directory(spec)
    case = read(ROOT / spec["material"])
    c = dict(ledger=ledger, spec=spec, directory=directory, call_ids=[], calls=[])
    ledger.start(spec["slot_id"])
    transports = []
    try:
        gateway, transports = live_gateway(c, keys=keys)
        result = await execute(spec, case, gateway, database_url=database_url)
        evidence = dict(
            material=case,
            result=result,
            calls=c["calls"],
            review_sources=c.get("review_sources", {}),
        )
        evidence["parsed_calls"] = [
            read(directory / f"{n:02}-parsed.json") for n in c["call_ids"]
        ]
        evidence["logical_requests"] = [
            read(directory / f"{n:02}-logical.json") for n in c["call_ids"]
        ]
        evidence["artifact_hashes"] = {
            p.name: sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in directory.iterdir() if p.is_file()
        }
        write_once(directory / "result.json", evidence)
        ledger.finish(spec["slot_id"], sha(canonical(evidence)))
        # Known technical/route/label failures stop before human gate. Semantic pass never automatic.
        label = next(
            (
                x.get("prelabel")
                for x in read(PARENT / "index.json")["materials"]
                if x["id"] == spec["case_id"] and x["lane"] == spec["lane"]
            ),
            None,
        )
        if label:
            if spec["lane"] == "plan_review":
                check = result["plan_check"]
                verdict = check["model_result"]["verdict"]
                route = check["server_assessment"]["route"]
                good = verdict in label["model_verdicts"] and (
                    route in ("needs_human", "reject")
                    if label["server_route"] == "needs_human_or_reject"
                    else route == label["server_route"]
                )
            else:
                good = (
                    result["review"]["result"]["verdict"] == label["expected_verdict"]
                    and result["review"]["local_routing"]["verdict"]
                    == label["expected_verdict"]
                )
            if not good:
                ledger.stop("FROZEN_LABEL_OR_ROUTE_MISMATCH")
        if spec["lane"] == "full_pipeline" and result["course_state"] != "completed":
            ledger.stop("FULL_PIPELINE_NOT_AUTOMATICALLY_COMPLETED")
    except BaseException:
        ledger.stop("FIRST_EXECUTION_FAILURE")
        if not (directory / "failure-summary.json").exists():
            write_once(
                directory / "failure-summary.json",
                dict(
                    kind="execution_failed",
                    call_ids=c["call_ids"],
                    artifact_hashes={
                        p.name: sha(p.read_bytes())
                        for p in directory.iterdir()
                        if p.is_file()
                    },
                    detail="No retry. Inspect private receipts and isolated DB; untrusted exception text withheld.",
                ),
            )
        raise
    finally:
        for transport in transports:
            await transport.aclose()


def assess(ledger, spec, value, manifest_hash):
    directory = case_directory(spec)
    result = read(directory / "result.json")
    state = next(x for x in ledger.snapshot()["cases"] if x[0] == spec["slot_id"])
    require(
        state[2] == "awaiting_human" and state[4] == sha(canonical(result)),
        "RESULT_BINDING_CHANGED",
    )
    verify_artifacts(directory, result)
    passed = check_assessment(
        value,
        schema=read(PARENT / "evaluation.schema.json"),
        spec=spec,
        manifest_hash=manifest_hash,
        evidence=result,
    )
    digest = write_once(directory / "evaluation.json", value)
    ledger.assess(spec["slot_id"], digest, passed)


def verify_prior(ledger):
    for row in ledger.snapshot()["cases"]:
        if row[2] == "passed":
            spec = next(x for x in slots() if x["slot_id"] == row[0])
            directory = case_directory(spec)
            result = read(directory / "result.json")
            value = read(directory / "evaluation.json")
            require(
                row[4] == sha(canonical(result)) and row[5] == sha(canonical(value)),
                "PRIOR_ASSESSMENT_CHANGED",
            )
            verify_artifacts(directory, result)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "action",
        choices=[
            "freeze",
            "check",
            "prepare-db",
            "activate",
            "run",
            "assess",
            "report",
            "stop",
        ],
    )
    parser.add_argument("--slot", choices=[x["slot_id"] for x in slots()])
    parser.add_argument("--evaluation", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.action == "prepare-db":
        verify_authorization()
        require(
            not (PRIVATE / "run.sqlite").exists(),
            "NO_DATABASE_PREPARATION_AFTER_ACTIVATION",
        )
        env = isolated_environment()
        for name in list(env):
            if name.endswith("API_KEY") or name.startswith("EDUMIND_PROVIDER"):
                env.pop(name, None)
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [
                str(ROOT / "backend/.venv/bin/python"),
                "-m",
                "alembic",
                "upgrade",
                "head",
            ],
            cwd=ROOT / "backend",
            env=env,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=60,
        )
        require(completed.returncode == 0, "ISOLATED_MIGRATION_FAILED")
        asyncio.run(verify_database(env["EDUMIND_DATABASE_URL"], empty=True))
        if not (PACKAGE / "environment-check.json").exists():
            require(
                not (PACKAGE / "manifest.json").exists(), "FROZEN_PACKAGE_CANNOT_EXTEND"
            )
            write_once(
                PACKAGE / "environment-check.json",
                dict(
                    database=DATABASE,
                    head="0033_learning_shared_budget",
                    empty=True,
                    provider_calls=0,
                ),
            )
        print(
            json.dumps(
                dict(database=DATABASE, empty=True, provider_calls=0, activated=False)
            )
        )
        return
    if args.action == "freeze":
        freeze()
    manifest_hash = verify()
    if args.action in ("check", "freeze"):
        active = (PRIVATE / "run.sqlite").exists()
        print(
            json.dumps(
                dict(
                    manifest_sha256=manifest_hash,
                    slots=29,
                    requests_max=59,
                    wall_seconds=18000,
                    labels_signed=16,
                    activated=active,
                    provider_calls=0 if not active else None,
                    execution_report="use report after activation",
                    T040="blocked",
                )
            )
        )
        return
    activated(manifest_hash)
    private_directory(PRIVATE)
    with (PRIVATE / "process.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        if args.action == "activate":
            require(not (PRIVATE / "run.sqlite").exists(), "NO_SECOND_ACTIVATION")
            # Check fresh isolated DB and credential availability before starting the five-hour clock.
            env = isolated_environment()
            asyncio.run(verify_database(env["EDUMIND_DATABASE_URL"], empty=True))
            load_keys(read(PACKAGE / "manifest.json")["env_metadata"])
            ledger = Ledger(
                PRIVATE / "run.sqlite", manifest_hash, slots(), activate=True
            )
        else:
            ledger = Ledger(PRIVATE / "run.sqlite", manifest_hash, slots())
        if args.action == "run":
            require(args.slot is not None, "SLOT_REQUIRED")
            verify_prior(ledger)
            spec = next(s for s in slots() if s["slot_id"] == args.slot)
            url = None
            if spec["lane"] == "full_pipeline":
                env = isolated_environment()
                url = env["EDUMIND_DATABASE_URL"]
                asyncio.run(verify_database(url, empty=True))
            keys = load_keys(read(PACKAGE / "manifest.json")["env_metadata"])
            prior_mode = os.environ.get("EDUMIND_PRODUCT_MODE")
            try:
                if spec["lane"] == "full_pipeline":
                    os.environ["EDUMIND_PRODUCT_MODE"] = "dynamic"
                asyncio.run(
                    run_slot(ledger, spec, manifest_hash, keys, database_url=url)
                )
            finally:
                if prior_mode is None:
                    os.environ.pop("EDUMIND_PRODUCT_MODE", None)
                else:
                    os.environ["EDUMIND_PRODUCT_MODE"] = prior_mode
        elif args.action == "assess":
            require(
                args.slot is not None and args.evaluation is not None,
                "SIGNED_EVALUATION_REQUIRED",
            )
            spec = next(s for s in slots() if s["slot_id"] == args.slot)
            assess(ledger, spec, read(args.evaluation), manifest_hash)
        elif args.action == "stop":
            ledger.stop("EXPLICIT_USER_STOP")
        print(json.dumps(ledger.snapshot()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        print(
            "Admission command failed closed; no automatic retry, fallback, or old-run reopening.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        sys.exit(1)

"""Independent durable admission ledger. No credentials, network or implicit run activation."""

import os
import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from acceptance_support.five_hour_runtime import require
from acceptance_support.qwen_review_budget import canonical, sha

RUN_ID = "plan-admission-execution-r01"


def schedule(index):
    rows = []
    for lane in ("plan_review", "fixed_review", "generation_draft"):
        for item in index["materials"]:
            if item["lane"] == lane:
                rows.append(
                    dict(
                        slot_id=f"{lane}:{item['id']}:1",
                        case_id=item["id"],
                        lane=lane,
                        cap=4 if lane == "generation_draft" else 1,
                        material=item["material"],
                        material_sha256=item["sha256"],
                    )
                )
        if lane == "fixed_review":
            for name in index["repeat_review_ids"]:
                item = next(x for x in index["materials"] if x["id"] == name and x["lane"] == lane)
                rows.append(
                    dict(
                        slot_id=f"{lane}:{name}:2",
                        case_id=name,
                        lane=lane,
                        cap=1,
                        material=item["material"],
                        material_sha256=item["sha256"],
                    )
                )
    item = next(x for x in index["materials"] if x["id"] == "G03")
    rows.append(
        dict(
            slot_id="full_pipeline:G03:1",
            case_id="G03",
            lane="full_pipeline",
            cap=19,
            material=item["material"],
            material_sha256=item["sha256"],
        )
    )
    require(len(rows) == 29 and sum(x["cap"] for x in rows) == 59, "SCHEDULE_CHANGED")
    return rows


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self, path, manifest_hash, slots, *, activate=False, now=time.time):
        self.path, self.now, self.slots = Path(path), now, slots
        require(not self.path.is_symlink(), "UNSAFE_LEDGER")
        if activate:
            fd = os.open(self.path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
            os.close(fd)
            with self.db() as db:
                db.executescript("""
                    CREATE TABLE run (manifest TEXT, t0 REAL, last_clock REAL, halt TEXT);
                    CREATE TABLE cases (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, position INTEGER, state TEXT,
                                        started REAL, result_hash TEXT, evaluation_hash TEXT);
                    CREATE TABLE calls (n INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, slot TEXT, stage TEXT,
                                        state TEXT, logical_hash TEXT, evidence_hash TEXT);
                """)
                t = now()
                db.execute("INSERT INTO run VALUES (?,?,?,NULL)", (manifest_hash, t, t))
                db.executemany(
                    'INSERT INTO cases VALUES (?, ?, "pending",NULL,NULL,NULL)',
                    [(r["slot_id"], i) for i, r in enumerate(slots)],
                )
        require(
            self.path.is_file() and self.path.stat().st_mode & 0o077 == 0,
            "PRIVATE_ACTIVE_LEDGER_REQUIRED",
        )
        with self.db() as db:
            require(
                db.execute("SELECT manifest FROM run").fetchall() == [(manifest_hash,)],
                "RUN_BINDING_CHANGED",
            )
            require(
                db.execute("SELECT id FROM cases ORDER BY position").fetchall()
                == [(s["slot_id"],) for s in slots],
                "ORDER_CHANGED",
            )

    @contextmanager
    def db(self):
        db = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=10)
        try:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            yield db
            db.commit()
        except BaseException:
            db.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            db.close()

    def clock(self, db):
        t0, last, halt = db.execute("SELECT t0,last_clock,halt FROM run").fetchone()
        require(halt is None, "RUN_STOPPED")
        t = self.now()
        if t < last or t >= t0 + 18000:
            reason = "CLOCK_MOVED_BACKWARD" if t < last else "GLOBAL_DEADLINE"
            db.execute("UPDATE run SET halt=?", (reason,))
            db.commit()  # Halt survives the exception; waiting never restarts T0.
            raise ValueError(reason)
        db.execute("UPDATE run SET last_clock=?", (t,))
        return min(60, t0 + 18000 - t)

    def start(self, slot):
        require(slot in [x["slot_id"] for x in self.slots], "UNKNOWN_SLOT")
        with self.db() as db:
            self.clock(db)
            rows = db.execute("SELECT id,state FROM cases ORDER BY position").fetchall()
            prior = [state for name, state in rows[: [name for name, _ in rows].index(slot)]]
            require(all(x == "passed" for x in prior), "INDEPENDENT_PRIOR_ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED")
            require(dict(rows)[slot] == "pending", "CASE_REPLAY_FORBIDDEN")
            require(
                not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM cases WHERE state="running"').fetchone(),
                "INTERRUPTED_CASE_NO_REPLAY",
            )
            require(
                not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM calls WHERE state!="complete"').fetchone(),
                "UNCERTAIN_ATTEMPT_NO_REPLAY",
            )
            db.execute('UPDATE cases SET state="running",started=? WHERE id=?', (self.now(), slot))

    def reserve(self, slot, stage, logical_hash):
        spec = next(x for x in self.slots if x["slot_id"] == slot)
        allowed = {
            "plan_review": {"plan_check"},
            "fixed_review": {"unit_review"},
            "generation_draft": {"plan_generation", "resource_generation"},
            "full_pipeline": {
                "plan_generation",
                "plan_check",
                "resource_generation",
                "resource_correction",
                "resource_review",
                "unit_review",
            },
        }[spec["lane"]]
        require(stage in allowed, "CROSS_LANE_OR_UNPLANNED_STAGE")
        with self.db() as db:
            remaining = self.clock(db)
            state, start = db.execute(
                "SELECT state,started FROM cases WHERE id=?", (slot,)
            ).fetchone()
            require(state == "running", "CASE_NOT_RUNNING")
            if self.now() >= start + 180:
                db.execute('UPDATE run SET halt="OPERATION_DEADLINE"')
                db.commit()
                raise ValueError("OPERATION_DEADLINE")
            remaining = min(remaining, start + 180 - self.now())
            require(
                not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM calls WHERE state!="complete"').fetchone(),
                "UNCERTAIN_ATTEMPT_NO_REPLAY",
            )
            n = db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM calls").fetchone()[0]
            own = db.execute("SELECT stage FROM calls WHERE slot=? ORDER BY n", (slot,)).fetchall()
            require(n < 59 and len(own) < spec["cap"], "REQUEST_CAP")
            stages = [x[0] for x in own]
            if spec["lane"] == "generation_draft":
                require(
                    stage == ("plan_generation" if not stages else "resource_generation"),
                    "DRAFT_SEQUENCE_CHANGED",
                )
            if spec["lane"] == "full_pipeline":
                require(stage != "plan_generation" or not stages, "SECOND_PLAN_FORBIDDEN")
                require(stage != "plan_check" or stages == ["plan_generation"], "PLAN_CHECK_ORDER")
                if len(stages) < 2:
                    require(
                        stage == ("plan_generation" if not stages else "plan_check"),
                        "PLAN_BEFORE_CONTENT",
                    )
                require("unit_review" not in stages, "AFTER_FINAL_REVIEW")
                if stage == "resource_generation":
                    require(
                        stages[-1] in ("plan_check", "resource_review"), "RESOURCE_SEQUENCE_CHANGED"
                    )
                if stage == "resource_review":
                    require(
                        stages[-1] in ("resource_generation", "resource_correction"),
                        "REVIEW_WITHOUT_NEW_CONTENT",
                    )
                if stage == "resource_correction":
                    require(stages[-1] == "resource_review", "CORRECTION_WITHOUT_REVIEW")
                    last_gen = max(
                        i for i, value in enumerate(stages) if value == "resource_generation"
                    )
                    require(
                        stages[last_gen:].count("resource_correction") < 2,
                        "PER_RESOURCE_CORRECTION_CAP",
                    )
                if stage == "unit_review":
                    require(stages[-1] == "resource_review", "FINAL_REVIEW_SEQUENCE_CHANGED")
                require(
                    stages.count("resource_generation") + (stage == "resource_generation") <= 3,
                    "RESOURCE_CAP",
                )
                require(
                    stages.count("resource_correction") + (stage == "resource_correction") <= 5,
                    "CORRECTION_CAP",
                )
                if stage == "unit_review":
                    require(stages.count("resource_generation") == 3, "INCOMPLETE_RESOURCES")
            db.execute(
                'INSERT INTO calls VALUES (?,?,?,"reserved",?,NULL)',
                (n + 1, slot, stage, logical_hash),
            )
            return n + 1, remaining

    def complete(self, n, evidence_hash):
        with self.db() as db:
            require(
                db.execute("SELECT state FROM calls WHERE n=?", (n,)).fetchone() == ("reserved",),
                "ATTEMPT_NOT_RESERVED",
            )
            db.execute(
                'UPDATE calls SET state="complete",evidence_hash=? WHERE n=?', (evidence_hash, n)
            )

    def finish(self, slot, result_hash):
        with self.db() as db:
            self.clock(db)
            require(
                not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM calls WHERE state!="complete"').fetchone(),
                "UNCERTAIN_ATTEMPT",
            )
            require(
                db.execute("SELECT state FROM cases WHERE id=?", (slot,)).fetchone()
                == ("running",),
                "CASE_NOT_RUNNING",
            )
            spec = next(s for s in self.slots if s["slot_id"] == slot)
            count = db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM calls WHERE slot=?", (slot,)).fetchone()[0]
            require(
                count > 0 and (spec["lane"] == "full_pipeline" or count == spec["cap"]),
                "INCOMPLETE_CASE_CALLS",
            )
            db.execute(
                'UPDATE cases SET state="awaiting_human",result_hash=? WHERE id=?',
                (result_hash, slot),
            )

    def assess(self, slot, evaluation_hash, passed):
        require(type(passed) is bool, "QUALITY_DECISION_REQUIRED")
        with self.db() as db:
            self.clock(db)
            require(
                db.execute("SELECT state FROM cases WHERE id=?", (slot,)).fetchone()
                == ("awaiting_human",),
                "HUMAN_ASSESSMENT_NOT_EXPECTED",
            )
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE cases SET state=?,evaluation_hash=? WHERE id=?",
                ("passed" if passed else "failed", evaluation_hash, slot),
            )
            if not passed:
                db.execute('UPDATE run SET halt="FIRST_FAILURE"')
            elif not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM cases WHERE state!="passed"').fetchone():
                db.execute('UPDATE run SET halt="COMPLETED_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY"')

    def stop(self, reason):
        with self.db() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE run SET halt=coalesce(halt,?)", (reason,))

    def snapshot(self):
        with self.db() as db:
            return dict(
                run=db.execute("SELECT * FROM run").fetchone(),
                cases=db.execute("SELECT * FROM cases ORDER BY position").fetchall(),
                calls=db.execute("SELECT * FROM calls ORDER BY n").fetchall(),
            )


def pointer(root, path):
    require(path.startswith("/"), "ABSOLUTE_POINTER_REQUIRED")
    for part in path[1:].split("/"):
        part = part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
        root = root[int(part)] if isinstance(root, list) else root[part]
    return root


def output_fields(value, path):
    """Enumerate model text fields; humans may split one field into several assertions."""
    if isinstance(value, str) and value:
        return {path}
    result = set()
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for k, v in value.items():
            if k not in {
                "schema_version",
                "prompt_version",
                "resource_type",
                "reference_ids",
                "anchors",
                "target_anchor",
                "evidence_anchors",
                "finding_id",
            }:
                result |= output_fields(v, path + "/" + k.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1"))
    if isinstance(value, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(value):
            result |= output_fields(v, path + f"/{i}")
    return result


def check_assessment(value, *, schema, spec, manifest_hash, evidence):
    from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator

    Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(value)
    require(
        value["status"] == "evaluated" and value["mode"] == "real", "REAL_HUMAN_ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED"
    )
    require(
        value["evaluator"] == dict(name="Lee", role="independent_human", signed=True),
        "LEE_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED",
    )
    require(
        value["run_id"] == RUN_ID
        and value["slot_id"] == spec["slot_id"]
        and value["case_id"] == spec["case_id"]
        and value["lane"] == spec["lane"]
        and value["package_manifest_sha256"] == manifest_hash,
        "ASSESSMENT_BINDING_CHANGED",
    )
    calls = evidence["calls"]
    require(
        value["artifacts"]
        == dict(
            material_sha256=spec["material_sha256"],
            request_sha256=sha(canonical([c["logical_request_sha256"] for c in calls])),
            response_sha256=sha(canonical([c["parsed_sha256"] for c in calls])),
        ),
        "EVIDENCE_CHANGED",
    )
    require(all(x is not None for x in value["scores"].values()), "SCORES_INCOMPLETE")
    claims = {c["id"]: c for c in value["claims"]}
    require(len(claims) == len(value["claims"]) and bool(claims), "ASSERTION_INVENTORY_REQUIRED")
    for claim in claims.values():
        for p in claim["evidence_pointers"]:
            pointer(evidence, p)
    required_fields = set()
    required_citations = set()
    for i, item in enumerate(evidence.get("parsed_calls", [])):
        body = item["value"]
        required_fields |= output_fields(body, f"/parsed_calls/{i}/value")
        n = calls[i]["n"]
        for finding in body.get("findings", []):
            anchors = finding.get("anchors", finding.get("evidence_anchors", []))
            if "target_anchor" in finding:
                anchors = [*anchors, finding["target_anchor"]]
            required_citations |= {f"{n}:{a}" for a in anchors}
    covered = {p for c in claims.values() for p in c["evidence_pointers"]}
    require(required_fields <= covered, "ALL_OUTPUT_FIELDS_MUST_BE_REVIEWED")
    ids = {c["anchor_id"] for c in value["citations"]}
    require(required_citations == ids, "ALL_ACTUAL_CITATIONS_REQUIRED")
    for citation in value["citations"]:
        require(set(citation["supports_claim_ids"]) <= claims.keys(), "UNKNOWN_CLAIM_REFERENCE")
        source = pointer(evidence, citation["source_pointer"])
        require(
            isinstance(source, str) and citation["quoted_source"] in source,
            "CITATION_QUOTE_NOT_IN_FIELD",
        )
        require(
            citation["source_pointer"]
            == "/review_sources/" + citation["anchor_id"] + "/source_text",
            "EXACT_ANCHOR_FIELD_REQUIRED",
        )
    if value["scores"]["quality_success"] and spec["lane"] in ("generation_draft", "full_pipeline"):
        require(
            value["scores"]["teaching_coverage"] == "pass", "GENERATED_TEACHING_COVERAGE_REQUIRED"
        )
        if spec["lane"] == "full_pipeline":
            require(
                evidence["result"]["course_state"] == "completed"
                and value["automatic_publication_completed"] is True,
                "AUTOMATIC_FULL_COMPLETION_REQUIRED",
            )
    # Completeness and semantic support are human attestations, not machine-proven truth.
    require(value["scores"]["quality_success"] is not None, "QUALITY_DECISION_REQUIRED")
    return value["scores"]["quality_success"]

class WireTransport(httpx.AsyncBaseTransport):
    """No header persistence, redirect/retry or secret reflection. Adapter pins public target."""

    def __init__(self, context, role, target, inner=None):
        self.context, self.role, self.target = context, role, target
        self.inner = (
            inner if inner is not None else httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport(retries=0, trust_env=False)
        )

    async def handle_async_request(self, request):
        c, cfg = self.context, CONFIG[self.role]
        base = urlsplit(cfg["base_url"])
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        require(
            request.method == "POST"
            and request.url.scheme == "https"
            and request.url.host in self.target.addresses
            and ipaddress.ip_address(request.url.host).is_global
            and (request.url.port or 443) == 443
            and request.url.path == base.path + "/responses"
            and request.headers.get("host") == base.netloc
            and request.extensions.get("sni_hostname") == base.hostname,
            "OUTBOUND_TARGET_CHANGED",
        )
        require(
            body.get("model") == cfg["model"]
            and body.get("reasoning") == {"effort": cfg["reasoning"]}
            and body.get("temperature") == 0
            and body.get("stream") is False
            and body.get("max_output_tokens") == c["expected_cap"],
            "WIRE_CONFIG_CHANGED",
        )
        require(not any(k.encode() in request.content for k in c["keys"]), "SECRET_IN_REQUEST_BODY")
        # Recheck just before physical send; reservation already committed by EvidenceGateway.
        with c["ledger"].db() as db:
            remaining = c["ledger"].clock(db)
        require(remaining > 0, "GLOBAL_DEADLINE")
        n = c["active_call"]
        directory = c["directory"]
        c["wire_request_sha256"] = write_once(
            directory / f"{n:02}-request.json",
            dict(
                wire=json.loads(request.content),
                wire_hex=request.content.hex(),
                wire_sha256=sha(request.content),
                host=base.netloc,
                sni=base.hostname,
                path=request.url.path,
                connect_ip=request.url.host,
                stage=c["stage"],
                logical_request_sha256=c["logical_request_sha256"],
            ),
        )
        response, raw = None, bytearray()
        c["actual_wire_sha256"] = sha(request.content)
        c["expected_config_sha256"] = sha(
            json.dumps(
                dict(
                    provider="deepseek_responses",
                    host=base.hostname,
                    model=body["model"],
                    reasoning=body.get("reasoning"),
                    temperature=body.get("temperature"),
                    max_output_tokens=body.get("max_output_tokens"),
                ),
                sort_keys=True,
            ).encode()
        )
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            response = await self.inner.handle_async_request(request)
            async for chunk in response.stream:
                require(len(raw) + len(chunk) <= 4 * 1024 * 1024, "RAW_RESPONSE_LIMIT")
                raw.extend(chunk)
            decoded, metadata = inspect_body(raw, response.headers, c["keys"], complete=True)
            c["decoded_response_sha256"] = sha(decoded)
            c["raw_response_sha256"] = write_once(directory / f"{n:02}-response.bin", bytes(raw))
            write_once(
                directory / f"{n:02}-receipt.json",
                dict(
                    status=response.status_code,
                    raw_sha256=c["raw_response_sha256"],
                    raw_bytes=len(raw),
                    decoded_bytes=len(decoded),
                    safe_headers=metadata,
                    duration_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000),
                    provider_error=safe_fields(decoded, request.content)
                    if response.status_code >= 400
                    else None,
                ),
            )
            return httpx.Response(
                response.status_code, headers=response.headers, content=bytes(raw), request=request
            )
        except BaseException:
            c["ledger"].stop("TRANSPORT_OR_RESPONSE_FAILURE")
            # Unsafe/oversized/reflected bodies are deliberately withheld, never printed.
            write_once(
                directory / f"{n:02}-failure.json",
                dict(
                    kind="transport_or_response_failure",
                    response_status=response.status_code if response else None,
                    received_bytes=len(raw),
                    received_sha256=sha(bytes(raw)),
                    body_withheld=True,
                    usage=None,
                ),
            )
            raise
        finally:
            if response is not None:
                await response.aclose()

    async def aclose(self):
        await self.inner.aclose()


def review_sources(request, n):
    """Resolve exact supplied anchor fields, never adjacent text, into a private audit view."""
    payload = json.loads(request.prompt.messages[-1].content)
    sources = {}
    for anchor in payload.get("anchor_catalog", []):
        if "resource_id" in anchor:
            candidates = payload.get("unit", {}).get("candidates", [])
            if "candidate" in payload:
                candidates = [payload["candidate"]]
            candidate = next(c for c in candidates if c["resource_id"] == anchor["resource_id"])
            field = pointer(candidate["envelope"]["content"], anchor["json_pointer"])
        elif anchor["source_kind"] == "user_request":
            field = payload["authoritative_teaching_goal"]["user_request"]
        else:
            root = (
                payload["unverified_plan"]
                if anchor["source_kind"] == "plan"
                else payload["reference_bindings"]
            )
            field = pointer(root, anchor["json_pointer"])
        require(isinstance(field, str), "ANCHOR_STRING_REQUIRED")
        excerpt = field.encode("utf-8")[anchor["start_utf8"] : anchor["end_utf8"]].decode("utf-8")
        require(bool(excerpt), "ANCHOR_EMPTY")
        sources[f"{n}:{anchor['anchor_id']}"] = dict(source_text=excerpt, catalog=anchor)
    return sources


class EvidenceGateway:
    def __init__(self, gateway, context):
        self.gateway, self.c = gateway, context

    async def generate_structured(self, request, *, retry_safe=False):
        c = self.c
        require(not retry_safe, "RETRY_FORBIDDEN")
        logical = dict(
            stage=request.stage, prompt=asdict(request.prompt), schema=request.json_schema
        )
        raw = canonical(logical)
        require(not any(k.encode() in raw for k in c.get("keys", [])), "SECRET_IN_LOGICAL_REQUEST")
        n, remaining = c["ledger"].reserve(c["spec"]["slot_id"], request.stage, sha(raw))
        c.update(
            active_call=n,
            stage=request.stage,
            expected_cap=request.prompt.max_output_tokens,
            logical_request_sha256=sha(raw),
        )
        c["call_ids"].append(n)
        for field in (
            "actual_wire_sha256",
            "expected_config_sha256",
            "decoded_response_sha256",
            "wire_request_sha256",
            "raw_response_sha256",
        ):
            c.pop(field, None)
        try:
            write_once(c["directory"] / f"{n:02}-logical.json", logical)
            c.setdefault("review_sources", {}).update(review_sources(request, n))
            async with asyncio.timeout(remaining):
                result = await self.gateway.generate_structured(request, retry_safe=False)
            require(
                result.transport_audit.request_digest == c.get("actual_wire_sha256")
                and result.transport_audit.response_digest == c.get("decoded_response_sha256")
                and result.transport_audit.config_digest == c.get("expected_config_sha256"),
                "ACTUAL_TRANSPORT_AUDIT_MISMATCH",
            )
            parsed = dict(
                value=dict(result.value),
                usage=asdict(result.usage),
                model=result.model_id,
                transport_audit=asdict(result.transport_audit),
            )
            require(
                not any(k.encode() in canonical(parsed) for k in c.get("keys", [])),
                "SECRET_REFLECTED",
            )
            h = write_once(c["directory"] / f"{n:02}-parsed.json", parsed)
            item = dict(
                n=n,
                stage=request.stage,
                logical_request_sha256=sha(raw),
                parsed_sha256=h,
                wire_request_sha256=c.get("wire_request_sha256"),
                raw_response_sha256=c.get("raw_response_sha256"),
                actual_wire_sha256=c.get("actual_wire_sha256"),
                decoded_response_sha256=c.get("decoded_response_sha256"),
            )
            write_once(c["directory"] / f"{n:02}-evidence.json", item)
            c["ledger"].complete(n, sha(canonical(item)))
            c["calls"].append(item)
            return result
        except BaseException:
            c["ledger"].stop("REQUEST_OR_CONTRACT_FAILURE")
            raise


def live_gateway(context, *, keys, inner_factory=None, guard_factory=None):
    """Build adapters after activation. The default guard enforces public SSRF policy."""
    context["keys"] = keys
    transports = []

    def adapter(role, cls, key):
        cfg = CONFIG[role]
        guard = (
            guard_factory(cfg["base_url"])
            if guard_factory
            else ProviderTargetGuard(cfg["base_url"], TargetPolicy())
        )
        target = guard.approve_base()
        wire = WireTransport(
            context, role, target, inner=inner_factory(role) if inner_factory else None
        )
        transports.append(wire)
        return ProviderGateway(
            cls(
                ProviderSettings(cfg["base_url"], key, cfg["model"]),
                guard,
                transport=wire,
                reasoning_effort=cfg["reasoning"],
            )
        )

    pair = LearningStageGateway(
        adapter("generation", DeepSeekResponsesAdapter, keys[0]),
        adapter("review", CandidateReviewAdapter, keys[1]),
    )
    return EvidenceGateway(CandidateGateway(pair), context), transports

            owner = uuid4()

            await db.flush()
            db.add(
                LearningPathVersion(
                    id=UUID(inputs.teaching_context["path_version_id"]),

                    version=1,
                    graph_version=graph.graph_version,

            )
            db.add(op)
            await db.commit()
            oid = op.id

            try:
                result = await run_planned_operation(
                    db, owner_id=owner, operation_id=oid, inputs=inputs, gateway=gateway
                )
            except BaseException as exc:
                # Export durable history even after a network/schema/cancellation failure.

                result = dict(
                    status="not_completed",
                    safe_error_code=exc.code
